name: Autonomous engineering loop
description: The Director (main session) grills, plans, gates and merges; agents build, review and audit each vertical slice. Hooks run on every session event regardless of stage.

stages.label: Grill
stages.description: Settle every human decision before any slice exists: UX calls (with an approved UI contract and prototype), one-way doors, risks. Decisions become ADRs; boundaries become fitness rules.

stages.label: Plan slices
stages.description: The planner turns the grilled spec into autonomous vertical slices; the Director lints the draft.

stages.label: Risk gate
stages.description: Score each slice 0-100; the class sets the controls. Critical slices wait for a human authorization.

stages.label: Dispatch
stages.description: Brief the builder (GOAL · SCOPE · ACCEPTANCE · VERIFY · FORBIDDEN · REPORT · STANDING); run independent slices in parallel worktrees.

stages.label: Build
stages.description: Minimum necessary change, test-first, on slice/<ID>; self-check with the gate, clean the diff, harden trust boundaries.

stages.label: Gate
stages.description: The Director runs gate.sh once at the builder's SHA: lint, types, tests, build, CRAP, mutation, markers, comments, scope, arch.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: Cold-eyes verdict against the acceptance criteria and the slop checklist, with blast radius and the evidence rung reached.

stages.label: Audit
stages.when: the slice has auditor_triggers, or its risk class is high or critical; otherwise recorded as skip

stages.label: Merge
stages.description: Risk check at the current patch-id (with any human approvals), squash-merge, tag, log the verdicts.

stages.label: Harvest
stages.description: Append the slice's story to vault/stories.md and prune it from the task tree.

stages.label: Every 5 slices
stages.description: Architecture review (code lens) and learning loop (process lens), dispatched together; candidates go to pending review.
